translator.evidence:
Original AI-assisted om catalog covers all 1315 English source messages in 12 family slices. Technical identifiers, standard notation, and formatting were retained where appropriate; no upstream translated catalog is claimed. Updated 2026-09-28 with 69 original messages for change review, agent questions, permission rules, connectors, background runs, research progress and budgets. Placeholders and locale-specific plural forms are preserved; no upstream translated text was copied.

2026-09-29 incremental pollRefresh review: added one original action label to this locale catalog, using existing refresh/update wording as context. The contribution remains AI-assisted and makes no human or native-speaker translator claim.

2026-09-29 incremental randomContentNext review: added one original action label ("Show another") to this locale catalog, using existing next/refresh wording as context. The contribution remains AI-assisted and makes no human or native-speaker translator claim.

2026-09-29 incremental taskListStepIncompleteAnnounce entry: added a formatting-only announcement template that interpolates the caller-supplied label and already-localized status, with the catalog punctuation convention. This is AI-assisted project localization; no human or native-speaker translator claim is made.

2026-09-30 incremental tableLoadingMore entry: added the loading-progress label for retrieving additional table rows, using the catalog's existing row/loading terminology. This original project contribution remains AI-assisted. No upstream translated text was copied; no human or native-speaker translator claim is made.

2026-10-02 incremental currencyPickerLabel contribution: added one locale-specific generic accessible field label for currency selection, following this catalog’s established UI register. The new label has no placeholders or plural branches. This narrow contribution remains AI-assisted and makes no human or native-speaker claim.

2026-10-03 incremental picker labels contribution: added five original messages (localePickerSearchLabel, localePickerEmpty, countryPickerLabel, timeZonePickerLabel, and unitPickerLabel) for language filtering, its empty result, and the country, time-zone, and measurement-unit field labels. Existing form wording informed the UI register. These messages have no placeholders or plural branches. This bounded contribution remains AI-assisted and makes no human or native-speaker claim. Updated 2026-10-06 for chartPlotSampled ("The chart shows a sample of up to 1,000 records; the data table lists all data."), the sampling notice shown when only the plot is sampled because the host supplied a complete custom data table, and for the reworded chartDataSampled, whose subject now names both the chart and its generated data table. Both were translated in source order from this catalog's own approved chartDataSampled and chartData wording, keeping its terms for chart, data table, sample and records and its exact 1,000 number formatting; neither is identical to the English source, so no allowlist entry was required. No upstream translated text was consulted; no human, native-speaker, or independent review is claimed for this increment.

2026-10-07: Added or updated the 37 retained localized messages for graph, retrieval, conversation, table, map and viewer surfaces, using established catalog terms where suitable and machine-assisted drafts elsewhere. Seven replaced or unused message keys were removed. Placeholder names, plural categories and exact package identifiers were retained. This is a project AI-assisted contribution, not a human or native-speaker translation claim.

2026-10-09: Added emojiPickerPeerMissing ("Emoji are not available."), the lr-emoji-picker message shown when the optional emoji data package is not installed, in source order after emojiPickerLoadError and reusing this catalog's own term for emoji from that neighbouring entry. No placeholders. This is a project AI-assisted contribution, not a human or native-speaker translation claim.

2026-10-10 incremental appRailPin and appRailUnpin entry: added the pin and unpin names for the lr-app-rail auto-hide pin control ("Pin navigation", "Unpin navigation"), reusing this catalog's own term for navigation from its appRailCollapse and closeNavigation entries. No placeholders or plural branches. This is a project AI-assisted contribution, not a human or native-speaker translation claim.

reviewer.evidence:
AI-assisted independent semantic review read every message across all 12 slices. Corrected table-row terminology, untranslated selected-count and token-direction labels, and the artifact component label; checked key meaning, Oromo register, placeholders, plural structures, writing system, and English-identical entries. Source parser confirms complete ordered coverage. This review is not native-speaker certification. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.

2026-09-29 incremental pollRefresh review: an AI-assisted bounded review checked this new action label for meaning, UI action wording and absence of placeholders or exact-English copy. This review covers only this addition, not prior catalog entries; no human or native-speaker certification is claimed.

2026-09-29 incremental randomContentNext review: an AI-assisted bounded review checked this new action label for meaning, UI action wording and absence of placeholders or exact-English copy. This review covers only this addition, not prior catalog entries; no human or native-speaker certification is claimed.

2026-09-29 incremental taskListStepIncompleteAnnounce review: an independent AI-assisted bounded review checked the announcement template in all 66 supported locale records for the supplied {label}/{status} placeholders, locale punctuation, and absence of untranslated English prose. The six locale-specific separator forms were checked; de-CH inherits its German template. This covers only this addition, not prior catalog entries, and claims no human or native-speaker certification.

2026-09-30 incremental tableLoadingMore review: an independent AI-assisted bounded review checked the added progress label across all 66 resolved locale catalogs (65 authored values and the de-CH German inheritance) for the meaning of loading additional rows, ongoing progress rather than row creation, and consistency with existing tableLoading terminology and UI register. The label has no placeholders or plural-category branches. Sixty-four resolved values were accepted unchanged; Japanese and Lingala were refined before this snapshot. This review covers only this addition; the updated catalog hash binds that addition to the existing reviewed catalog without claiming a new linguistic review of older messages. Review tier remains AI-assisted; no human or native-speaker certification is claimed.

2026-10-02 incremental currencyPickerLabel review: an independent AI-assisted bounded review checked this new generic accessible field label across all 66 resolved locale catalogs for currency meaning, script, orthography, and the existing UI register. All 65 authored values and the Swiss German inheritance were accepted unchanged. This review covers only the new label, not prior catalog entries, and claims no human or native-speaker certification.

2026-10-03 incremental picker labels review: an independent AI-assisted bounded review checked the five new messages (localePickerSearchLabel, localePickerEmpty, countryPickerLabel, timeZonePickerLabel, and unitPickerLabel) across all 66 resolved locale catalogs for intended meaning, script, search and empty-result polarity, grammatical number where relevant, and accessible field-label terminology. The 65 authored locale slices and de-CH German inheritance were read against the English source. Lingala and Amharic measurement-unit labels were made explicit before the final reviewed snapshot. Only Malay unitPickerLabel intentionally matches English and receives a locale-specific allowance. This review covers these five additions only; it does not claim a new linguistic review of earlier entries, human review, or native-speaker certification. Hosted structural validation and updated snapshot binding are separate from this semantic review. Updated 2026-10-06 for chartPlotSampled and the reworded chartDataSampled. An AI-assisted review, separate from the contributor that drafted them, checked both values in this catalog for meaning (both the chart and its generated table are sampled; only the plot is sampled while a custom table lists all data), agreement with the compound subject, consistency with this catalog's chart and data-table terminology and its exact 1,000 number formatting, and the locale's clause punctuation; both were approved without correction and no English-identical allowlist entry was required. No human or native-speaker review is claimed.

2026-10-07 bounded AI-assisted second pass: checked all new placeholders and pinned plural categories, sampled changed values against English intent and established catalog vocabulary, and examined map-attribution and retrieval/context wording across locales. Clear false friends in map attribution and an Odia mixed-script corruption were corrected. English-identical entries were classified individually as punctuation, formatting templates, technical token terms or valid shared totals headings. Broader historical catalog nuance was not re-audited. Approval here records this bounded AI-assisted review only, not human or native-speaker certification. Idiom in this locale remains low confidence pending qualified human review.

2026-10-09 incremental emojiPickerPeerMissing review: an AI-assisted bounded review, separate from the contributor that drafted it, checked this one value against its neighbouring emojiPickerLoadError entry for meaning (the emoji set is unavailable, not a failed load or an empty search), UI register, the catalog's emoji term, script and sentence punctuation. Approved without correction in 64 of 65 catalogs; the one suggested change (Igbo) was not applied because the drafted negative copula is complete as written. No English-identical allowlist entry was required. No human or native-speaker review is claimed.

2026-10-10: the updated catalog hash binds appRailPin and appRailUnpin to the existing reviewed catalog. No separate linguistic review of these two values is claimed; they remain an unreviewed AI-assisted draft, and no human or native-speaker review is claimed.
